metadata.title: Services
metadata.description: Premium solar energy solutions and turnkey construction services.

work_process.title: Work Process
work_process.description: Complete engineering, construction and project management in Bulgaria and abroad.

steps.ground_desc: We build high-efficiency ground-mounted photovoltaic plants with fixed structures or trackers, optimized for maximum sun exposure and energy yield.
steps.rooftop_desc: We design and install rooftop solar systems for industrial buildings and homes, using reliable structures without compromising insulation.
steps.carport_desc: We create innovative solar parking sheds that combine car protection with clean electricity production for charging stations or self-consumption.
steps.floating_desc: We implement floating photovoltaic systems using water surfaces for efficient clean energy production. Our approach ensures platform stability, resistance to external conditions, and optimal performance.
